rules.message: JsonNode/ObjectNode is an untyped payload (SC-TYPE). Define a record/DTO and deserialize straight into it (readValue(body, Record.class)); do not pass the tree around. Waive on the same line with `stackcrew-allow: SC-TYPE <reason>`, only where a dynamic payload is first deserialized and mapped to a record right after, or where a framework API requires the type (for example a Kafka client config Map<String, Object>, or Jwt.getClaims()).

Map<String, Object> is an untyped bag (SC-TYPE). Define a record/DTO with named fields, or Map<String, KnownType> when every value has one type. Waive on the same line with `stackcrew-allow: SC-TYPE <reason>`, only where a dynamic payload is first deserialized and mapped to a record right after, or where a framework API requires the type (for example a Kafka client config Map<String, Object>, or Jwt.getClaims()).

Map<?, ?> hides both key and value types (SC-TYPE). Use Map<KnownKey, KnownValue>, or a record/DTO when the keys are fixed. Waive on the same line with `stackcrew-allow: SC-TYPE <reason>`, only where a dynamic payload is first deserialized and mapped to a record right after, or where a framework API requires the type (for example a Kafka client config Map<String, Object>, or Jwt.getClaims()).

Hardcoded URL (SC-CONST). Environment URLs belong in @ConfigurationProperties / application.yml; a `static final` constant is only for fixed protocol identifiers (an XML namespace, a schema URI), never for an environment URL. Waive on the same line with `stackcrew-allow: SC-CONST <reason>`.
